description: No key needed to preview: without an API key it returns a watermarked preview image (at most 512 px) and a claim_url, and no vector file. Show the preview, then ask the person to open the claim link (they sign up free and get 5 credits); then download_vector with the token returns the SVG (1 credit from their account). Without a key, pass token instead of an image to trace the same image again with other colors or preset (at most 3 times). With an API key (free to create) it converts a raster image (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP or TIFF) into a vector file. Each call with a key costs 1 credit, and a failed conversion is not charged. Pass image_url or image_base64. Returns an image token, the credits left and a signed download link valid for 1 hour; the file itself is included when it is at most inline_max_bytes (default 16 KB; PNG up to 1 MB, as an image). Use download_vector with the token to get more formats for free. If you may retry (after a timeout, say), pass an idempotency_key: a repeat with the same key and arguments within 24 hours returns the first result and is not charged again. When images are waiting their turn, the result can instead have status "queued" with the token and retry_after_seconds, and nothing is charged yet: after that many seconds call download_vector with the token (charged then). Do not convert the image again.

colors.description: Palette size. Leave out to use the preset default.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. Same key and arguments within 24 hours: the first result, charged once. The same key with other arguments is an error.

image_base64.description: The image as base64 (a data: URL works too).

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image.

inline_max_bytes.description: Largest file, in bytes, to include in the result itself (default 16384; 1048576 for PNG). Larger files come only as the download link. 0 never inlines.

preset.description: logo (colour) or bw (black and white logo).

token.description: Instead of an image: an image token (img_…) to trace again with other colors or preset.

name: convert_image_to_svg

download_url.description: Signed link to the file, no key needed.

inline.description: Whether the file is in the result content.

svg.description: The SVG markup, when the format is svg and the file is inlined.

title: Convert image to vector
